tokens_per_run (subagent_tokens).verdict: The diet did not save tokens: +3.5k mean per run (+5%). Complex jobs got cheaper (j01-reel -14.1k, r04 -9.1k, j08 -7.8k, j02 -5.9k) because SKILL.md itself is 9 KB smaller; every one-step job got 8-14k more expensive because the new intro ('every flag in detail: references/scripts.md', 'the long form ... worth reading before a job in that area') and step 0 ('before the first job on a machine you have not used this session') sent agents to scripts.md, gotchas.md and doctor before doing anything. Quality held at iteration-10 levels on every dimension, so the diet stays and 1.11.1 fixes the wording (fix PR: this file is enough for a job, references only for an open question, doctor only after a failure, --json-brief on every writing step); iteration 12 re-measures.

findings: Token cost went up, not down: the two-tier split and the doctor guidance were read as 'read the second tier and run doctor first'. Fixed in 1.11.1 by wording, to be re-measured in iteration 12.
--json-brief is not adopted on its own (5/36 runs used it on a writing step); SKILL.md now asks for it on every writing step.
